import Mathlib

theorem putnam_2020_a2
  (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  have h_main : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ j in Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j = 4 ^ k := by

      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> omega
  
  exact h_main k
